question: If x² - 4x - 3 = 0, then what is the value of frac{{( {{x⁴}} right. - left. {frac{{27}}{{{x²}}}} )}}{{({x²} + 4x - 3)}}?
solution:
**Given:**

x2 - 4x - 3 = 0

**Concept Used:**

a³ - b³ = (a - b) (a² + ab + b²)

**Calculation:**

 x2 - 4x - 3 = 0 ______(1)

on dividing eq 1 by 2x we get,

(x / 2) - (3/2x) = 2 ____(2)

now in eq 1

x2 - 4x + 8x - 8x - 3 = 0 (on adding both sides by 8x) 

x2 + 4x - 3 = 8x ______(3)

on solving frac{{( {{x⁴}} right. - left. {frac{{27}}{{{x²}}}} )}}{{({x²} + 4x - 3)}}

(x⁶ - 27) / [x²(x² + 4x - 3)] 

(x6 - 27)/8x³ _________(x2 + 4x - 3 = 8x ) (from eq 3)

(x³ /8) - (27/8x³)

(x/2)³ - (3/2x)³

(x/2 - 3/2x)³ + 3 x (x/2) x (3/2x) (x/2 - 3/2x)

(2)³ + (9/4 x 2)

8 + 9/4 x 2

25/2

12(1)/(2)

**therefore, the value of frac{{( {{x⁴}} right. - left. {frac{{27}}{{{x²}}}} )}}{{({x²} + 4x - 3)}}is 12(1)/(2)**

**Given:**

x2 - 4x - 3 = 0 

**Formula used:**

(a - b)³ = a³ - b³ - 3ab(a - b)

**Calculation:**

x2 - 4x - 3 = 0

x(x - 4 - 3/x) = 0

⇒ x - 3/x = 4

Cubing both the sides:

(x - 3/x)³ = 4³

⇒ x³ - 27/x³ - 3 × x × 3/x (x - 3/x) = 64 

⇒ x3 - 27/x3 = 64 + 3 × 3 × 4

⇒ x3 - 27/x3 = 100

frac{{( {{x⁴}} right. - left. {frac{{27}}{{{x²}}}} )}}{{({x²} + 4x - 3)}}

⇒ frac{{x( {{x³}} right. - left. {frac{{27}}{{{x^x}}}} )}}{{x({x} + 4 - (3)/(x))}}

⇒ 100 / 4 + 4

⇒ 50 / 2 = 12(1)/(2)
